description: Follows one budget approval until it is final or wait_seconds pass (at most 25). Pass the approval link the Superstables CLI printed, or the request_id submit_budget_request returned for this account. Returns what get_budget_request returns. A request awaiting the owner doesn't establish whether the owner has approved it, a transaction in a block is not final until the chain says so, and an unknown outcome is not a failure. Moves no funds.

approval_link.description: The approval link the CLI printed, as printed

wait_seconds.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds until the request is final. Use 25 while it is not.

name: wait_budget_request
title: Wait for a budget approval
